tags: Scores higher for video creators whose content attracts more NIP-22 comments (kinds 21, 22, 34235, 34236).
content:
plan
  videos = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [21, 22, 34235, 34236], authors: [_.targetPubkey], limit: 50}
in then
  events = videos | [],
  n = length(events),
  videoIds = map(events, fn(e ~> fetch(e, .id))),
  comments = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [1, 1111], '#e': videoIds, limit: 100}
in
let
  cList = comments | [],
  total = length(cList)
in
if n == 0 then 0.0
else if total > 50 then 1.0
else if total > 25 then 0.85
else if total > 10 then 0.7
else if total > 3 then 0.5
else if total > 0 then 0.25
else 0.0
